title: Audit the complete G20 caller and exact port interfaces
body:
The latest G20 local native audit leaves the global caller as a separate obligation. This package binds the exact [PR5708](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5708) stream to every controller/local operation and checks all **317004 events, 11022 arbitrary public inputs, 48 arbitrary dirty owned inputs, 56223 query sources and 2529 owned episodes**. It imports no predecessor Python implementation. The exact local native theorem from [PR5782](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5782) is an authenticated dependency.

The new finite interface certificate constructs **all 111 rational port normalizers and both inverses**, with denominator least common multiple 4. It proves that the actual local entrance/exit frames give the stage involution and central shear required by the controller. Reverse propagation checks every formal group-algebra coefficient on 32 banks. Separate forward and transpose scalar interpreters each check **122544900 coefficients** through exact bitmaps. Every target has one public owner and its exact native interface. The peak live owned reserve is the full 48 banks.

The complete positive finite allowance is **952838314401 primitive invocations**, including parking, owned state, query dimension work, routes and 10944 charged matcher coefficients. The actual targets require 7176 external routes; the retained allowance of 7320 includes 144 spare routes from retired helpers. This is a verified conservative bound, not a new κ or a speedup. [Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/eaa9cc8c15d8e994d7b81b0cda3f6dd63b0db826/research/g20-global-caller-audit/PROOF.md) · [receipt and complete port matrices](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/eaa9cc8c15d8e994d7b81b0cda3f6dd63b0db826/research/g20-global-caller-audit/RESULT.json).

Registered normal and optimized Python 3.12 replay pass in 8.98 seconds. Ten semantic controls reject false geometry/epochs, wrong routes and interfaces, dirty leakage, duplicate targets, missing charges and public erasure. Four actual frozen-source byte corruptions reject. Committed bytes/modes and official export pass. A separate read-only, Git-free replay with empty PATH under `-I -O -W error -B` passes in 4.08 seconds; all 34 exported files retain their bytes and modes. [Validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/eaa9cc8c15d8e994d7b81b0cda3f6dd63b0db826/research/g20-global-caller-audit/VALIDATION.md).

Run `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-global-caller-audit`.

This resolves the finite global binding, target/owned ledger, operator polynomial and base-fee audit boundary. It does not rerun the native audit or ordinary interval engine, prove physical tape tariffs, or discharge uniform compiler, stock, precision, analytic or compatible Gaussian/outer obligations. The source ordinary saving .003507719059749 is not re-admitted here. Hosted CI, full-history ancestry checking in this shallow checkout and independent human scientific acceptance remain separate. Selected frontier unchanged; no merge or closure.

Fresh base/main: `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority 8. Source PR5708: `829d01fc031f7323ffcfa423fdfd1f24dcbe3190`; native dependency PR5782: `50e19025f7efdb956bf3bb887da30470efc185ef`. [Canonical scoped handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5777#discussioncomment-19202911). Credit Dugongue PR5657/5665, ai-nanachi PR5512, the PR5679/5708 construction, local native audit and all retained controller/native/helper/compiler/ordinary authors. New checker, explicit port witnesses and proof by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
